title: Repère BenchmarkRow (one JSONL line)
description: Transcribed from the BenchmarkRow dataclass in src/repere/export.py and the validity rules in docs/dataset_submission.md section 2. The dataclass is the contract; this file is a convenience for external submitters and has not been generated from it.

id.description: Globally unique: dataset_id/suite_id/item_id. Must start with this row's dataset_id and suite_id (checked by tests, not by this schema).

suite_id.description: File name stem of the JSONL.

version.description: Bump when any prompt or gold changes.

task_kind.description: repere.TaskKind. Add an enum member in src/repere/__init__.py before using a new value.

visibility.description: validation rows are public, test rows are private. A test row never appears in a committed or published file.

prompt.description: Exactly what the model is shown. Must not contain the answer, the checker logic or a corpus id.

gold.description: Any JSON value. Shape is fixed by scorer_spec.name: object for json_extraction, number array for numerical_regression, relevant-id list for retrieval_metrics.

name.description: Resolved by the suite family's make_scorer_from_spec. Must be registered there.

metadata.description: Free-form but use these keys so the leaderboard can slice: difficulty (easy|medium|hard), cutoff_date (ISO date or null), category, source_case (id in the upstream truth set).
